messages:
eli (partner-eng): quick sync request — we're packaging a One-Click Orchestrator onramp that wires LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters + gateway connector + hardware accel profiles into a marketplace bundle. need: announcement cadence, embargo window, who owns the demo kit + smoke tests, and marketplace SKU/pricing suggestions. thoughts?

alex: +1. this needs a short private beta before any public announce. propose: 2-week partner beta (3 ISVs/SIs), then public listing + co-announcement. embargo window: 48 hours before public listing for partner comms. also want a tiny cert badge ("Redwood Verified Adapter") so customers know it's supported.

maya: demo kit checklist: sample app repo, prebuilt container image, prompt templates, terraform/helm quickstart, and a smoke test script. i can own the sample app + README. will need partner-signed test creds from SI folks. doc draft: https://redwood.example/docs/oneclick-onramp (WIP).

jon: compatibility matrix notes: list model adapters (LLamaIndex, LangChain), runtimes (cpu, gpu, fp16, 4-bit/8-bit q), seq-length supported, and hardware SKUs (A100, H100, T4). gating: must pass smoke tests on at least 2 hardware SKUs for "verified" badge. will add an automation job that runs the smoke test across variants.

sara: marketplace / pricing: we'll need bundle SKUs — suggest "One-Click Orchestrator — Starter" (pay-as-you-go hosted) and "One-Click Orchestrator — Enterprise" (reserved/dedicated + support). Partner co-sell pricing notes: revenue share + marketing credits. also confirm billing metadata fields for marketplace listing (product_id, sku, tier).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke-test/oneclick-job #492 PASSED — 2026-03-02T15:22Z (helm chart v0.3.1) :white_check_mark:

eli (partner-eng): thanks. proposed public timeline:
- Mar 2: start partner beta (invite 3 ISVs + 2 HW partners)
- Mar 16: end beta, collect feedback, finalize badge
- Mar 23: public marketplace listing + joint announcement (press embargo opens Mar 21 00:00 PT)

eli (partner-eng): quick technical snippets for the demo kit (put these in the README):
```bash
# helm quickstart for partner sandbox
helm repo add redwood https://charts.redwood.example
helm install redwood-orch redwood/oneclick-orch --set adapters.langchain=true --set adapters.llamaindex=true --set hw.profile=h100-small

# smoke test (runs basic prompt + embedding)
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-oneclick-v1","input":"Summarize: the purpose of this test"}'
```

maya: i'll add the repo + sample app by EOD Friday. can someone from eng add the hw profiles to the orchestration chart? (cc @jon)

jon: will add hw profiles and the cross-SKU smoke job. expect PR by Thu. i'll also add a test matrix CSV to the repo so partners can run local validation.

eli (partner-eng): action items + owners:
- demo sample app + README: maya — due Fri 2026-03-05
- hw profile + CI smoke job: jon — PR by Thu 2026-03-04
- marketplace SKU + legal pricing blurb: sara — draft by Mon 2026-03-08
- partner invites + beta roster: eli — invites sent by Tue 2026-03-02
- announcement draft & co-announcement ops: alex + maya — draft by Mar 12

eli (partner-eng): one safety / compliance note: for the private beta we need partner NDA covers for demo data. legal flag: include compliance checklist in partner invite.

alex: ack. i'll draft the joint announcement cadence and start partner comms template.

maya: ack, will start README and demo assets.

jon: ack, starting hw-profile PR.

sara: ack, will draft pricing + billing fields.

eli (partner-eng): perfect. if anyone wants to add a sample prompt set or evals to the repo (we should include a tiny eval that checks for hallucination rate < 5% on the sample set), drop PRs to the demo repo. otherwise i'll ping partners tomorrow with invites. :rocket:
